Company: TiriVelo Pet Care Inc.
Location: Remote – Canada-based applicants preferred
Type: Internship 
Duration: 3–6 months
Commitment: 10–15 hours per week

About TiriVelo
TiriVelo Pet Care Inc. is a Canadian technology startup building a digital marketplace designed to connect pet owners with independent pet care providers.


We're building an experience centred around trust, safety, thoughtful design, and technology, while bringing together a multidisciplinary team of engineers, product designers, researchers, and business professionals.


We're currently looking for passionate Frontend Engineering Interns to join our growing engineering team and contribute to the development of our web platform.

About the opportunity
As a Frontend Engineering Intern, you'll work alongside our engineering and product design teams to translate high-fidelity Figma designs into responsive, accessible, and scalable web experiences.


You'll contribute to our upcoming website migration, frontend development backlog, and the continued development of our pet care marketplace.


This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience working within a collaborative engineering environment and contribute to a real product being prepared for launch and future growth.

What you'll be working on

- Develop and maintain frontend features using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Translate approved Figma designs into responsive, production-ready web interfaces.
- Build reusable components using our established design system.
- Implement responsive layouts using Tailwind CSS.
- Integrate frontend experiences with Supabase authentication, databases, and backend services.
- Contribute to product experiences such as onboarding, booking, messaging, and payments.
- Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve frontend bugs.
- Support accessibility, performance optimization, and cross-browser compatibility.
- Participate in GitHub workflows, pull requests, and code reviews.
- Collaborate with frontend engineers, backend engineers, UX designers, and technical leadership.

Our current technology stack

- React
- Next.js (App Router)
- TypeScript
- HTML and CSS
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase and PostgreSQL
- Cloudflare Workers
- Git and GitHub
- Figma

What we're looking for

- Currently pursuing or recently completed studies in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Web Development, or a related discipline.
- Hands-on experience with React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript.
- Familiarity with Next.js, preferably the App Router.
- Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive web development.
- Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
- Ability to translate design specifications into functional web interfaces.
- Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
- Ability to work independently within a remote team environment.
- A willingness to learn, receive feedback, and take ownership of assigned development tasks.

Nice to have

- Experience with Tailwind CSS.
- Familiarity with Supabase, PostgreSQL, or API integrations.
- Experience working with Figma designs and component-based design systems.
- Understanding of web accessibility standards.
- Familiarity with Cloudflare or modern web deployment environments.
- Experience with automated testing or frontend testing frameworks.
- Personal projects, academic projects, or open-source contributions demonstrating your development abilities.

What you'll gain

- Practical experience contributing to a real-world technology platform.
- Exposure to modern frontend engineering tools and development workflows.
- Experience collaborating with a multidisciplinary product development team.
- Opportunities to participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and engineering planning.
- Experience implementing professional UX/UI designs.
- Mentorship and guidance from experienced team members.
- An opportunity to strengthen your technical skills and professional portfolio, subject to company confidentiality and portfolio approval requirements.

Internship details

- Fully remote.
- Approximately 10–15 hours per week.
- Duration of 3–6 months, with flexibility based on academic program requirements.
- Flexible scheduling to accommodate academic commitments.
- Unpaid internship, subject to applicable employment laws and academic placement eligibility.

How to apply
Interested applicants are encouraged to submit their resume along with a GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of relevant development projects.


Apply through LinkedIn or submit your application to careers@tirivelo.com.


We look forward to meeting curious, motivated developers who are excited to help build something meaningful.
fit_why: Strong React/Next.js/TypeScript/Postgres fit; Tailwind, Supabase-adjacent, but unpaid, 10-15h/week

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. Through our broad technology expertise and one of the most extensive product portfolios in the industry, we are Connecting Everyone and Everything, All the Time.

At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management, and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creative thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together are changing the way the world communicates.

Requisition ID: 79160

Description

We're seeking a talented and motivated DevOps Engineer Intern to join our team for the Spring of 2027. As a key member of our DevOps team, you'll play a vital role in building and maintaining our core infrastructure, working with cutting-edge tools.

Responsibilities

Actively participate in team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and project planning.

Contribute to exciting projects within our core infrastructure, leveraging your technical skills and knowledge.

Assist in supporting program requests and ensuring smooth operations.

Utilize JIRA to manage your tasks effectively and track progress.

Required Experience And Skills

Pursuing a BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

Must have completed the junior year by May 2026.

Enrolled in an educational program for the full duration of the internship.

Desired Experience And Skills

Coding Python, Java, C# or similar

Experience With Git Or Other Modern Source Control Tools

Must have good written and verbal communication skills

Experience With Jenkins Or Other Build Engines Is Preferred

The typical pay range for an Engineering intern across the U.S. is currently USD $29.00 - $49.00 per hour and for a Non-Engineering intern across the U.S. is currently USD $23.00 - $42.00 per hour. Starting pay will depend on level of education, the ultimate job duties and requirements, and work location. Skyworks has different pay ranges for different work locations in the U.S.

Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Skyworks strives to create an accessible workplace; if you need an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@skyworks.com.
fit_why: DevOps internship, Jenkins/Java/C# and infra focus, not his software stack

 Front-End Engineer Internship – 2027 (US)
 Job ID: 10609992 | Amazon.com Services LLC

 Apply now 

 Description
 Are you excited to build products that are used by Amazon customers all over the world? As a Front-End Engineer Intern, you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with experienced developers to create the user-facing side of software. You’ll collaborate with team members and stakeholders on UX and the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, software design, code, testing, documentation, deployment, and maintenance.

Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day.

Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. By applying to this position, your application will be considered for all Front-End Engineer Internship roles at all locations we hire for in the United States ,including but not limited to: Greater Seattle Area (Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond), Greater Bay Area (San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara), Greater DMV (DC, MD, VA), Austin (TX), New York City (NY), Minneapolis (MN), Chicago (IL ).

You will be able to provide your preference of location and start date during the application process but, we cannot guarantee that we can meet your selection based on several factors including but not limited to the availability and business needs of this role. Finalization on the location and start dates available will be provided to you at the time of job offer.

Start dates for our internships in this posting include the following periods:
1. Winter (Starts January/February 2027)
2. Summer (Starts May/June 2027)
3. Fall (Starts August/September 2027)

Key job responsibilities
As a Front-End Engineer Intern, you will/may:
• Deliver software components and improvements to software features with your team’s software.
• Work with stakeholders and product partners to deliver high-quality UX.
• Take feature specifications and deliver working code that is maintainable and extendable. 
• Help provide operational support for your team and work to ensure that root causes are identified and resolved. 
• Participate in code reviews and daily stand-ups. 
• Collaborate with your team to positively impact the software quality, customer experience, and maintainability of your team’s products. 

A day in the life
In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in fun activities with other interns throughout the summer. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your internship and learn in a real-world setting.

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving
personal growth. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

 Basic Qualifications
 - Are 18 years of age or older
- Work 40 hours/week minimum and commit to 12 week internship maximum
- Are enrolled in a academic program that is physically located in the United States
- Experience in JavaScript
- Experience with CSS
- Experience with HTML
- Experience in at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., JavaScript, Python, C#)
- Knowledge of computer science fundamentals (e.g., data structures & algorithms, OO design)
- Currently working towards a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Science, Web Development, Human-Computer Interaction, or other equivalent discipline, with an expected conferral date between October 2027 – December 2030.

 Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience in one or more relevant front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, etc.
- Knowledge of UX best practices
